demo_banner: Demo build — every record shown is fully synthetic placeholder data
demo_hint: Demo sign-in: demo_owner, demo_rep or demo_finance / password: Demo-2026 — see docs/CLIENT_DEMO.md
login_hint: Use your company account to open the invoice desk.
home_start_hint: Build a draft invoice from the demo products and warehouse; the server computes the final totals.
demo_note_numbers: Every number comes from the server; the underlying data is synthetic.
demo_note_ledger: These receipts are pre-loaded synthetic opening data, not output of a live cycle.
server_totals_note: The server recalculates and stores the authoritative totals.
draft_scope_note: A saved draft does not reduce stock or receivables; that only happens at posting.
posting_disabled_hint: Posting is disabled by the server safety gate (HTTP 409) — successful posting is never simulated in this demo.
demo_note_stock: The balances shown are pre-loaded synthetic opening balances in the demo database.
balances_note: Balance = sum of ledger entries (posted invoices + synthetic opening balances − receipts); saving a draft never changes it.
demo_note_receipts: Receipts are pre-loaded synthetic data; the safety gate blocks new collections (HTTP 409).
err_lines: Add at least one valid line.
err_line_incomplete: Complete every line: pick a product and enter a quantity above zero.
read_only_role: Your role is read-only; invoices cannot be created.
